body.segment: The 14-3-3 ? isoform is required for normal stomatal opening mediated by PHOT2 in Arabidopsis thaliana.
Arabidopsis PHOTOTROPIN2 (PHOT2) interacts with the ?-isoform 14-3-3 protein both in yeast two-hybrid screening and in an in vitro pull-down assay.
Further yeast two-hybrid analysis also showed that the PHOT2 C-terminal kinase domain was required for the interaction.
Site-directed mutagenesis indicated that PHOT2 Ser-747 is essential for the yeast interaction.
